_note: contact-moments-on-pipelinq-schema. One contact moment schema in the fleet: pipelinq's. This fragment gives the contactmoment facet of `ticket` its direction as a first-class field, and widens `caseReference` from a UUID pointed at one named app into an ADR-048 semantic reference to https://openregister.app/ns#Case. Fragments are deep-merged onto pipelinq_register.json in filename order, so this one lands after 99-unify-ticket-supertype.json only for keys it names; everything it does not name is untouched.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Which way the contact ran: inbound (the party contacted us), outbound (we contacted the party) or internal (a note between handlers). Required on a contactmoment; left unset on a request or a complaint, whose direction is implied by the type. Kept as a field of its own rather than inside channelMetadata, because a facet cannot be built over a free-form envelope and every competitor in the register carries it first-class.

caseReference.title: Case Reference
caseReference.description: The case this ticket belongs to, as an ADR-048 semantic reference to https://openregister.app/ns#Case. Allowed on a request (the case it converted into) and on a contactmoment (the case it was logged against). No app id and no concrete slug: whichever installed app implements the case type answers it, and existing UUID values stay valid because the reference is still a uuid string.
